name: Saturn Risin9
bio: Saturn Risin9 is an American queer performance artist, singer, filmmaker, DJ, and actress.

credits.title: Club Kid
credits.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

credits.title: Saturn Risin9
credits.overview: Queer performance artist and musician Saturn Risin9 returns home to the Bay Area to share their journey of perseverance centering self discovery, healing and creative expansion poetically told through dance, visual narrative, performance, and documentary.
